name: branding-puzzle-gift-box-and-basket-illustration-for-retail-launch
title: Retail-launch puzzle kit: blue gift box, gummy-covered puzzle, red basket illustration and welcome letter
whatItIs: A tall board showing a royal blue box opened to reveal tubs, a welcome card with a wavy blue seal, a puzzle whose picture is a hand-painted red shopping basket full of brand products, a canister labelled 'Run Puzzle 48 pieces', a puzzle close-up with gummies, a red 'Now at' card and a printed letter.
whatItMeans: Joyful and clever; a puzzle turns 'the missing piece' message into a physical gift.
techniques: Make the message ('missing piece') a puzzle.
Illustrate a basket of products in painterly gouache.
Match box, canister and letter to a blue-red palette.

vocabulary.definition: A box of items sent to promote a launch.
A wave-edged shape holding a message.
